environment.note: Governed repository-only LIFETIME follow-up to GFX-161 (ADR-0120). Branched from current main c649c550 (= GFX-161 squash 70c26724 + one disjoint intervening commit #686 'isolated TradersWay-Demo winter-timezone observation path' GFX-TIM ADR-0121, zero analytics overlap). Additive, migration-free correction to the LIFETIME currency resolution in analytics/portfolio.py (ADR-0122). DEFECT (same blank->USD root pattern ADR-0120 fixed for the DAILY path, proven by the two defect tests): when an account's currency could not be established (live balance read failed AND no fresh tenant-local snapshot AND blank account_currency -- the production norm), build_summary passed account_net_pnl the balance-label currency cur=normalise_currency(snap or account_currency)=USD (blank->USD) and passed portfolio_metrics an observed_nonusd_ids set derived from that same cur. An unestablished-currency account collapsed to USD: account_net_pnl summed its native realized as a USD net_pnl (38.04 'USD'), and portfolio_metrics placed it in the USD partition and summed its closed trades into net_pnl_total/profit_factor/expectancy/win-loss with basis='USD', state='OK' (false completeness). FIX: (1) account_net_pnl returns None when the caller-resolved account_ccy == UNKNOWN_CURRENCY; (2) build_summary passes each account's unknown-preserving resolved currency rc = realized_ccy[id] (the SAME GFX-161 map) to account_net_pnl (rc==cur for established currencies -> byte-identical) and computes unknown_ids = {id: rc==UNKNOWN_CURRENCY}; (3) portfolio_metrics/_partition_usd accept unknown_ids and exclude those accounts from the USD partition exactly like a non-USD account -> PARTIAL (USD subset measured) / UNAVAILABLE (net_pnl_total null, total_trades null), never a native sum as USD, never a false $0.00, never cross-tenant (map keyed by id). observed_ccy (blank->USD) is passed to portfolio_metrics UNCHANGED, so the single-currency conversion (ADR-0066) and balance/equity/metrics for established scopes are byte-identical. Frontend: ONE truthfulness label change (from the 8-lens review): the currency_unconvertible metrics context label in metricsStateLabel (page.tsx) is made denomination-neutral EN+JA, because an UNKNOWN-currency account can now drive that state and the old copy wrongly asserted 'non-USD accounts excluded'. Everything else renders via the existing GFX-161 machinery (UNAVAILABLE->N/A + context, PARTIAL->measured + 'N included/M excluded', null net_pnl as '-'); a dedicated test plus the updated summary-row-stability assertions lock it. No migration, no flag, no schema/DB change, no backfill, no snapshot fabrication, no broker/MT5/host contact. Out of scope (documented in ADR-0122 + KNOWN_ISSUES): per-account trade-history and /api/analytics/daily-pnl/ are single-account NATIVE figures (not USD-aggregated), structurally immune; the broker-server-calendar-day window shared with the daily aggregate remains a platform-wide follow-up.

limitations: Repository-only. No production deploy, no flag, no schema/DB change, no backfill, no snapshot fabrication, no broker/MT5/host contact. Production backend is unchanged by this packet.

Scope is the LIFETIME per-account net P&L (account_net_pnl) and portfolio-wide metrics (portfolio_metrics) only. The per-account trade-history and /api/analytics/daily-pnl/ series are single-account NATIVE figures (not USD-aggregated across accounts) and are structurally immune to the sum-as-USD aggregate defect; they are proven unchanged, not rewritten. The broker-server-calendar-day window shared with the daily aggregate remains a separate platform-wide follow-up (KNOWN_ISSUES).

The fix lives in build_summary (the layer that resolves authoritative currency, consistent with the existing observed_nonusd_ids pattern and ADR-0120). A DIRECT unit caller of portfolio_metrics/account_net_pnl that supplies no currency knowledge intentionally keeps the documented blank->USD estate default -- those callers cannot know an account's currency. The lifetime metrics block exposes a single block-level reason (currency_unconvertible) for both non-USD and unknown exclusions by existing design; the finer per-account reason distinction (rate_unavailable vs unknown_currency) lives in the daily excluded_detail (GFX-161). A scope mixing a convertible known-non-USD account with an unestablished one is fail-closed UNAVAILABLE (the metrics single-currency conversion requires a homogeneous established-currency scope) -- never overstated.
